name: f-fix-s2-08
note: Fix variant 8 (seed 2): the gear chest full of stone; a plate-belt tile turned to face back; order: @{agent} no gears coming out of [gps={gx},{gy}], what's up with it?
setup_lua:
-- Shared helpers for the x-* harder scenarios (pasted at the top of each setup_lua by x-gen.py). Positions are
-- absolute; each setup picks its own origin with find_near/find_ring and adds offsets.
-- open(x, y, w, h): no water, ore or buildings in the box (trees and rocks get cleared).
-- find_near(cx, cy, w, h, rmax): the open box nearest to cx,cy (spiral search), generating chunks as needed.
-- find_ring(w, h, r0, r1): an open box between r0 and r1 tiles from the origin.
local s, f = game.surfaces.nauvis, game.forces.player
local D = defines.direction
local LAB = s.get_tile(200, 200).name == "landfill" -- the flat lab stage (448x448 landfill around spawn)
local function gen(x, y, w, h)
  local need = false
  for cx = math.floor(x / 32), math.floor((x + w) / 32) do
    for cy = math.floor(y / 32), math.floor((y + h) / 32) do
      if not s.is_chunk_generated { cx, cy } then
        s.request_to_generate_chunks({ cx * 32 + 16, cy * 32 + 16 }, 0)
        need = true
      end
    end
  end
  if need then s.force_generate_chunk_requests() end
end
local function open(x, y, w, h)
  gen(x, y, w, h)
  local a = { { x, y }, { x + w, y + h } }
  if s.count_tiles_filtered { area = a, collision_mask = "water_tile" } > 0 then return false end
  if s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, type = "resource" } > 0 then return false end
  if s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, type = "cliff" } > 0 then return false end
  return s.count_entities_filtered { area = a, invert = true,
    type = { "tree", "simple-entity", "corpse", "fish", "item-entity", "character" } } == 0
end
local function find_near(cx, cy, w, h, rmax)
  cx, cy = math.floor(cx), math.floor(cy)
  if open(cx, cy, w, h) then return cx, cy end
  for r = 4, rmax or 60, 4 do
    for i = -r, r, 4 do
      for _, p in pairs { { cx + i, cy - r }, { cx + i, cy + r }, { cx - r, cy + i }, { cx + r, cy + i } } do
        if open(p[1], p[2], w, h) then return p[1], p[2] end
      end
    end
  end
  error("no open " .. w .. "x" .. h .. " area near " .. cx .. "," .. cy)
end
local function find_ring(w, h, r0, r1)
  for r = r0, r1, 6 do
    for _, d in pairs { { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, -1 }, { 0.7, 0.7 }, { -0.7, 0.7 }, { 0.7, -0.7 },
      { -0.7, -0.7 } } do
      local x, y = math.floor(d[1] * r), math.floor(d[2] * r)
      if open(x, y, w, h) then return x, y end
    end
  end
  error("no open " .. w .. "x" .. h .. " area " .. r0 .. "-" .. r1 .. " tiles out")
end
local function clear(x, y, w, h)
  for _, e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered { area = { { x, y }, { x + w, y + h } },
    type = { "tree", "simple-entity", "item-entity", "corpse" } }) do e.destroy() end
end
local function put(name, x, y, dir, extra)
  local spec = { name = name, position = { x, y }, direction = dir, force = f }
  for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do spec[k] = v end
  local e = s.create_entity(spec)
  if not e then error("could not place " .. name .. " at " .. x .. "," .. y) end
  return e
end
local function source(x, y, items) -- an infinity chest that never runs out of each item in `items`
  local c = put("infinity-chest", x, y)
  for i, it in ipairs(items) do
    c.set_infinity_container_filter(i, { name = it, count = 50, mode = "exactly", index = i })
  end
  return c
end
local function sink(x, y) -- an infinity chest that deletes whatever goes in
  local c = put("infinity-chest", x, y)
  c.remove_unfiltered_items = true
  return c
end
local function grid(x, y, watts) -- an always-on power source, a corner of the main grid
  local e = put("electric-energy-interface", x, y)
  e.power_production, e.electric_buffer_size = (watts or 6000000) / 60, 10000000
  return e
end
local function gps(x, y) return math.floor(x) .. "," .. math.floor(y) end

local W, H = 36, 18
local ox, oy
if LAB then ox, oy = find_near(-60, -60, W, H, 120) else ox, oy = find_ring(W, H, 40, 200) end
clear(ox, oy, W, H)
local X, Y = ox + 4, oy + 4
local b = { furnaces = {}, poles = {} }
storage.bench_fix = b
grid(X - 3, Y + 8, 3000000)
for x = 0, 19 do put("transport-belt", X + x + 0.5, Y + 0.5, D.east) end
-- ore onto the south lane from the north, coal onto the north lane from the south (separate lanes: no jam)
source(X + 0.5, Y - 1.5, { "iron-ore" })
put("fast-inserter", X + 0.5, Y - 0.5, D.north)  -- 4 stone furnaces eat ~75 ore/min: more than a burner moves
put("small-electric-pole", X - 0.5, Y - 0.5)
source(X + 1.5, Y + 2.5, { "coal" })
put("burner-inserter", X + 1.5, Y + 1.5, D.south).insert { name = "coal", count = 50 }
for i = 0, 3 do
  local fx = 3 + 3 * i
  b["in" .. i] = put("inserter", X + fx + 0.5, Y + 1.5, D.north)
  local fu = put("stone-furnace", X + fx + 1, Y + 3)
  fu.insert { name = "coal", count = 5 }
  table.insert(b.furnaces, fu)
  b["out" .. i] = put("inserter", X + fx + 0.5, Y + 4.5, D.north)
end
-- medium poles reach both inserter rows
b.poles[1] = put("medium-electric-pole", X + 5.5, Y + 1.5)
b.poles[2] = put("medium-electric-pole", X + 11.5, Y + 1.5)
for x = 3, 20 do b["belt" .. x] = put("transport-belt", X + x + 0.5, Y + 5.5, D.east) end
b.ins_chest = put("inserter", X + 21.5, Y + 5.5, D.west)
b.plates = put("iron-chest", X + 22.5, Y + 5.5)
b.ins_asm = put("inserter", X + 23.5, Y + 5.5, D.west)
b.asm = put("assembling-machine-1", X + 25.5, Y + 5.5)
b.asm.set_recipe("iron-gear-wheel")
b.ins_out = put("inserter", X + 27.5, Y + 5.5, D.west)
b.gears = put("iron-chest", X + 28.5, Y + 5.5)
b.pole_chest = put("small-electric-pole", X + 21.5, Y + 4.5)
b.pole_asm = put("small-electric-pole", X + 27.5, Y + 4.5)
put("small-electric-pole", X - 1.5, Y + 7.5)
do  -- spares, as a base would have (the lab stage has no storage)
  local c = put("steel-chest", X - 3.5, Y + 11.5)
  for n, k in pairs { ["small-electric-pole"] = 20, ["inserter"] = 10, ["transport-belt"] = 50, ["coal"] = 50,
    ["iron-chest"] = 5, ["burner-inserter"] = 5 } do c.insert { name = n, count = k } end
end
put("small-electric-pole", X + 0.5, Y + 2.5)
put("small-electric-pole", X + 16.5, Y + 4.5)
b.gears.insert{name='stone', count=1600}
b.belt12.direction = D.west
return { fx = math.floor(X + 9), fy = math.floor(Y + 3), gx = math.floor(X + 28), gy = math.floor(Y + 5) }

objectives.name: fixed
objectives.goal: @{agent} no gears coming out of [gps={gx},{gy}], what's up with it?
objectives.answer: Your call. Everything it needs is there; don't hand-feed it.

score.name: gears_per_min
score.lua: local c=storage.bench_fix.gears return c.valid and c.get_item_count('iron-gear-wheel') or 0

score.name: furnaces_working
score.lua: local n=0 for _,f in pairs(storage.bench_fix.furnaces) do if f.valid and f.status==defines.entity_status.working then n=n+1 end end return n
